commands.name: git-branch
commands.description: Create and switch to a new feature branch with proper naming convention

commands.name: git-commit
commands.description: Create a conventional commit with proper formatting and validation

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Commit message in conventional format: type(scope): description

commands.name: git-pr
commands.description: Create a pull request with proper template and validation

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Pull request title describing the changes

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Optional pull request body with additional details

examples: /git-pr "Fix roster parsing memory leak" "Addresses issue with large roster files"

commands.name: git-merge
commands.description: Merge a branch with proper validation and cleanup

parameters.name: branch-name
parameters.description: Branch to merge into current branch

commands.name: git-tag
commands.description: Create a version tag and update changelog

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version tag in semantic version format (e.g., v0.1.0)
